'''Corgaide Marendevi''' is the [[Holder of the Keys]] in [[Cairhien]]. 

== Appearance ==
She is grave faced with gray hair.

== Activities ==
She greets [[Cadsuane Melaidhrin]] when she arrives in Cairhien and shows her to her room.

She tells [[Samitsu Tamagowa]] and [[Sashalle Anderly]] that [[Loial]] and [[Karldin Manfor]] have just arrived back in Cairhien.
